title: Yevaru leni Ontari – Janna Shaik, Jessy D Telugu Christian Lyrics
english: yevaru leni ontari daananu nenu yesayya
yevaru leni ontari daananu nenu yesayya
translation: Chorus:
I am a lonely person with no one around, oh Jesus
You became my support and comforted me
I am a lonely person with no one around, oh Jesus
You became my support and comforted me
Verse 1:
Even when worldly attachments surround and cause me pain
Even when my very own people abandon me and leave
Even when worldly attachments surround and cause me pain
Even when my very own people abandon me and leave
Just like You transformed the life of Ruth, oh Jesus
You transformed my bitterness (Marah) into sweetness, oh Jesus
You stood right beside me, You stayed as my companion
You wiped away my tears, my good Jesus
You stood right beside me, You stayed as my companion
You wiped away my tears, my good Jesus
Verse 2:
Even if the whole world looks at me and casts me out
Even if my loved ones leave me and mock me
Even if the whole world looks at me and casts me out
Even if my loved ones leave me and mock me
You wiped away Hannah’s tears, oh Jesus
You brought light into her life
You wiped away my tears, You filled me with joy
You showered Your love upon me, my good Jesus
You wiped away my tears, You filled me with joy
You showered Your love upon me, my good Jesus
intro: Yevaru leni Ontari is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Janna Shaik, tuned by Janna Shaik, sung by Jessy D and music composed by Tinnu Thereesh and produced by His Works Ministries. This song was released on June 28, 2026, through Janna shaik YouTube Channel.
